represents: Machine and service traffic in one production AWS account: EC2 instance-profile sessions (SSM agent, CloudWatch agent, EKS node kubelet / VPC CNI / ECR pulls, ECS agent, batch workers) calling from private IPs through VPC endpoints, from the NAT gateway EIPs (203.0.113.16/28, the own-egress placeholder) and over own IPv6 egress; AWS services acting on the account's behalf (EC2/Lambda/ECS credential vending, AWS Config, Auto Scaling, IAM Access Analyzer, an 'AWS Internal' SSM action); Lambda and ECS task roles; a mobile app's Cognito AUTHENTICATED-role sessions reading and writing user objects; Cognito GUEST (unauthenticated-role) sessions from Amplify Analytics endpoint registration before sign-in and from anonymous reads of the customer portal's public/ media prefix; and one legacy ops bastion in a public subnet whose instance role calls from its own auto-assigned public IPv4 (192.0.2.96/28). Template weights deliberately over-sample the activity adjacent to the rules in adjacent_to (and their documented false-positive classes), so a rule's hits and rate_per_10k on this slice are corpus figures, not a production rate.
provenance: synthetic; shapes from the AWS CloudTrail record contents and userIdentity reference (AssumedRole with sessionContext.ec2RoleDelivery, AWSService invokedBy, service-linked roles), the CloudTrail AssumeRole-by-AWS-service example, the S3 data-event reference, and this repo's TRR9011 / TRR9012 / TRR9016 fixtures. Agent user agents follow the SSM / CloudWatch / ECS agent and SDK formats. Account 123456789012; access keys ASIAEXAMPLE<digits>; tokens are placeholders; addresses RFC 1918 / RFC 5737 / 2001:db8::/32. Guest sessions follow the Amplify-generated (amplify-<app>-<env>-<id>-unauthRole) and Cognito-console (Cognito_<pool>Unauth_Role) role names; the Pinpoint call shape follows the Amazon Pinpoint CloudTrail examples (eventSource pinpoint.amazonaws.com, path parameters as 'application-id', masked body fields). Every S3 bucket and other named regional resource is logged in one region (awsRegion, Host and the TLS host header agree); only unnamed Describe/List calls use the 85/15 us-east-1/us-west-2 region mix.
